zone.en: For example, people who live in earthquake zones have to be prepared for danger.
zone.zh: 例如，生活在地震带的人们必须对危险做好准备。

zone.en: Within this zone, a country has the special rights to explore and use marine resources.
zone.zh: 在此区域内，一国拥有勘探和利用海洋资源的特殊权利。

zone.en: Aboriginal communities adapted to Australia’s deserts, wetlands, tropical regions, and temperate zones.
zone.zh: 原住民社群适应了澳大利亚的沙漠、湿地、热带地区和温带。

zone.en: France has one of the largest Exclusive Economic Zones in the world.
zone.zh: 法国拥有世界上最大的专属经济区之一。

zone.en: So, a habitable zone is an area where something could live.
zone.zh: 所以，宜居带就是可能存在生命居住的区域。
